title: Comprensión Básica de Los Estados Financieros
description: A Spanish-language, two-hour Zoom workshop from A Bookkeeping Cooperative on basic financial concepts and the four most common reports — profit & loss, budget, cash flow projection, and balance sheet. Interactive and designed for every level, from absolute beginners to people looking to communicate more clearly about finances. Sliding-scale tickets, including free tickets. 6-8pm ET (3-5pm PT).
